description: The baseline answers for the members the libs declare, not for the names they use. An `interface Math` written inside a module declares its own type and merges with nothing, so `mine.max` floors like any other hand-written bodyless declaration — the control that keeps `baseline-survives-a-lib-augmentation` from being a rule about spelling.

diagnostics.message: Call to `mine.max` escapes this `@nothrow` function: it is declared without a body — an ambient declaration, a `.d.ts`, or a value known only by its function type — and no mark, manifest, overlay, override or baseline entry colors it, so it is assumed to throw. Your outs, in precedence order: bridge this call with `try`/`catch`; assert the color in `nothrow.overrides.json`; install or write an `@no-throw/*` overlay; or, if you own the package, ship a manifest with `nothrow emit`.
